description: What the game's own window may reach. DENY BY DEFAULT: the renderer here is the whole game — a large web app with its own dependency tree — and it has no business holding a handle to the filesystem, the shell, the clipboard or a second window. The one thing it asks of the shell is a fullscreen toggle, which is an app command and needs no entry here. Tauri's own permissions are ACL entries rather than a runtime handler, and this file is that list.
